title: ParallelFor
author: JG
description: use ParallelFor with costs argument in GeneralContact and CSystem, to optimize usage
releaseNotes: superseded by the parallel assembly of the Jacobians of #1203 and #1202 (revision2026c steps RG9.11.5.2, RG9.11.5.3): 16 tasks per thread of equal numbers of items, taken as threads become free, reach 90 % of the ideal at 8 threads; the cost argument of ParallelFor only switches small loops to serial, which the multithreadedLowerLimit settings do (maintainer 2026-11-02)
